control_address.description: Unix socket path or port for the control interface (penctl).

run_as_user.description: User to run the pen process as (Unix only).

chroot_dir.description: Directory to chroot into. Leave empty if not using chroot.

blacklist_timeout.description: Seconds to blacklist a server that does not respond.

connect_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a connection to a backend server.

client_tracking_timeout.description: Seconds to track clients. 0 means never expire.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of client table entries.

max_connections.description: Default maximum simultaneous connections per backend server.

emergency_server.description: host:port of the emergency server if all regular servers are down.

use_hash.description: Use hash on client IP for initial server selection.

add_xff.description: Add X-Forwarded-For header to HTTP requests.

round_robin.description: Use round-robin selection instead of sticky sessions.

ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file.

ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL key file.

ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to the CA certificate file.

ssl_ca_dir.description: Path to the CA certificates directory.

backends.description: List of backend servers for load balancing. Each item must be an object with: host (string), port (number), max_connections (number), max_hard_connections (number), weight (number), priority (number). Leave empty if using command line only or dynamic config.
